meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发任务拆成可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你习惯先规划再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Break down development tasks into an executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer planning before writing code

howto.what: 装上后,你说“先规划”时 Claude 会宣告进入规划模式,只做只读探索并把需求拆成一份可直接执行的完整工作计划,自己不写代码。
howto.when: 仅在你明确要求先规划再写代码时触发,例如说出“ulw-plan”“plan this”“make a plan”等触发词,或用自己的话要求先做计划;不会自行激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我规划这个登录改造,先别写代码。
say.note: 进入规划模式,先探索再给你方案

say.text: plan before coding,先出一份完整实施计划。
say.note: 产出可执行计划,等你批准后才动工

say.text: 直接规划“认证优化”,细节你按最佳实践定。
say.note: 意图模糊时会自动选默认方案,少问你

howto.what_en: On activation, Claude announces planning mode, explores the codebase read-only, resolves open questions, and produces one decision-complete work plan for a worker to execute, without editing any product code.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on an explicit user request for planning before coding, e.g. saying "ulw-plan", "plan this", "make a plan", "plan mode", or asking for a work plan in your own words. It never self-activates.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan this login refactor; don't write code yet.
say_en.note: Enters planning mode, explores first then proposes a plan

say_en.text: Plan before coding — produce a full executable plan.
say_en.note: Plan is written only after your approval

say_en.text: Plan "auth improvements" — you pick best-practice defaults.
say_en.note: Fuzzy intent routes to defaults with fewer questions
